title: Percona: backup take (mysqldump)
description: Runs `nexus backup take percona --tag <t>`: mysqldump --single-transaction --skip-add-locks of nexus_smoke to a node-local gzip on a non-writer (--skip-add-locks because PXC strict_mode prohibits explicit LOCK TABLES).
whatProves: PerconaAdapter.BackupTakeAsync produces a non-empty PXC-strict-mode-safe logical dump of nexus_smoke.
